- [FACT] User is concerned about color accuracy of prints.
- [FACT] User has been working on editing photos using Lightroom and Photoshop.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Explained color management practices of various online printing services, including:
  - Mpix uses a custom-built color profiling system and provides ICC profiles for their papers.
  - Nations Photo Lab employs daily calibration and offers ICC profiles for download.
  - Shutterfly uses automated and manual color correction but does not provide ICC profiles.
  - Snapfish, Costco Photo Center, and Walmart Photo use proprietary color profiling systems but do not provide ICC profiles.
  - SmugMug provides ICC profiles for download for their most popular papers.
  - Google Photos uses automated color correction and does not provide ICC profiles.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided tips for achieving color accuracy, including using the recommended color space, soft-proofing images, using a color-calibrated monitor, embedding color profiles, and checking paper options.

  - Mpix offers E-Surface Paper (matte), Metallic Paper (glossy), and Kodak Pro Endura Paper (matte).
  - Nations Photo Lab offers Matte Paper, Velvet Paper (textured), and Bamboo Paper.
  - Shutterfly offers Matte Finish, Textured Finish, and Pearl Finish.
  - Snapfish offers Matte Finish, Textured Finish, and Premium Paper.
